name: Abducted Medic
comment: One of the three minifigures the Alien Mindslicer abducts (378128: SpawnMonster NQKR / ROT1 / 25XL, picked by one roll of 1–100: ≤33 / 34–66 / ≥67). The template (TDB 51000 #1480 "Abducted Medic") and look (the Medic's) from the user's memory (2026-10-30: he spawned the Medic and the Witch Doctor, level scaled); which hash is which is a guess. It comes at the Mindslicer's level (npc.rs SpawnHow::level) and heals like the Medic (same look, tunables enemy_abilities). 45 s: the death buff the Mindslicer puts on it (440446, TimeExist 4500, Health 0 when it ends).
